directory.profile.title: {name}'s profile
directory.profile.description: See this member's details, how to reach them, and their role.
directory.profile.offline: Disconnected. This is the last profile we received. You can start a new conversation once the connection is back.
directory.profile.offlineMissing: Disconnected. We could not find this member's last profile.
directory.profile.emptyHeadline: This member is not on the roster.
directory.profile.emptyDetail: Reload the roster, then check the profile again.
directory.profile.dmSelf: You cannot open a direct message from your own profile.
directory.profile.dmInactive: You cannot open a direct message while this member is {status}.
directory.manage.heading: Manage
directory.manage.hint: Only people with the {owner} or {admin} role see this
directory.role.label: Role
directory.role.lockedOwnerPeer: People with the {owner} role cannot change each other's roles.
directory.role.lockedAdminCeiling: The {admin} role cannot change the role of someone who is {admin} or {owner}.
directory.role.confirmGrantAdmin: The {admin} role can change the role of {member} and {guest} people, suspend or remove them, and create password reset links for them. It can also create channels and add or remove people in channels.
directory.role.confirmRevokeAdmin: They will no longer be able to change the role of {member} and {guest} people, suspend or remove them, create password reset links, create channels, or add and remove people in channels.
directory.role.confirmOwnerWarning: {name} will have the same permissions as you. People with the {owner} role cannot change each other's roles, suspend each other, or remove each other, but they can create password reset links for each other. This cannot be undone.
directory.lifecycle.suspendSignOut: They are signed out on every device right away and cannot sign in again until the suspension is lifted. Phone notifications stop as well.
directory.lifecycle.suspendKeeps: Their messages and channels stay as they are. While they are suspended, the {owner} and {admin} roles still see their name on their messages; everyone else sees a former-member label.
directory.lifecycle.suspendUndo: Suspended members stay under Suspended on the Members tab, where you can lift the suspension at any time. Only the {owner} and {admin} roles see that group.
directory.lifecycle.reinstateBody: They will be able to sign in again. Their earlier sign-ins are not restored, so they need to sign in again. Their channels are unchanged.
directory.lifecycle.reinstateSchedules: Scheduled messages held when they were suspended do not go out on their own after the suspension is lifted. They need to reschedule them or send them now.
directory.lifecycle.removeLeaves: They leave every channel and direct message and are signed out on every device right away. Their scheduled messages are cancelled.
directory.lifecycle.removeKeeps: Their messages and direct message history stay, with a former-member label in place of their name.
directory.lifecycle.removeWarning: This cannot be undone. Even with a new invite, the same email address cannot join this workspace again.
directory.lifecycle.errorNotActive: This member is no longer active. Someone else may have suspended them in the meantime.
directory.lifecycle.errorNotSuspended: This member is not suspended any more. Someone else may have lifted the suspension in the meantime.
directory.lifecycle.errorLastOwner: The workspace needs at least one person with the {owner} role, so this person cannot be suspended or removed.
directory.lifecycle.errorRank: You cannot suspend or remove a member whose role is the same as or higher than yours. Their role may have changed in the meantime.
directory.lifecycle.errorSelf: You cannot suspend or remove yourself.
directory.lifecycle.errorForbidden: You do not have permission to suspend or remove members in this workspace.
directory.lifecycle.errorNotFound: We could not find this member. They may have already left the workspace.
directory.lifecycle.errorRateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in a moment.
directory.lifecycle.errorNetwork: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
directory.lifecycle.errorUnknown: That did not go through. Try again.
